newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui Eng wins 5.5 bln yen S.Arabia plant order.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Eng wins 5.5 bln yen S.Arabia plant order.

text.p: Mitsui Engineering & Shipbuilding Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it had won a 5.5 billion yen turnkey order for an epoxy resin plant from Arabian Industrial Development Co of Saudi Arabia.

The plant, to be built in Al-Jubail, Saudi Arabia, would be able to produce 20,000 tonnes of epoxy resin a year, Mitsui said in a statement. It was expected to be completed in October 1998, Mitsui said.
It would be the first epoxy resin plant in the Middle East, Mitsui said.
Epoxy resin is used to make paint and adhesives.
